## Library.Reference:1 - One connected language, several kinds of whole

The Library becomes useful when a question crosses boundaries that an isolated answer leaves unresolved. A sound model may be unusable with the available observations. A feasible design may lack an authorized commitment. A helpful AI answer may leave the person unable to make the next judgement independently. In each case, the missing contribution has to be identified and connected to the work that consumes it.

The common language makes these differences expressible. Core distinguishes a System, a Method, its description, performed Work, capability, evidence and authority. The domain languages explain what those distinctions require in particular practices. A mathematical consequence, a corporate decision and an acquired bodily skill therefore retain different construction and qualification conditions while participating in one undertaking.

FPF Library is an organized collection of related framework publications with this connected public account. Its unity of description comes from shared meanings, general Methods, explicit dependencies and developed returns between contributions. That does not establish one discipline above every field in the collection. A Library-wide explanation can be necessary even when the explained publications describe several independently constituted disciplines.

Within the Library, a Suite makes a stronger subject claim: it describes a composite discipline through constituent DPFs and their connections. Engineering, Management, Foundational Thinking and Human Capability Engineering each have an account of that whole. A DPF outside those Suites keeps its own subject; its Methods can supply contributions to the same work. Neither arrangement determines how many publications a particular task needs.

This distinction follows [FPF E.4's ecosystem architecture](FPF-Spec.md#e4---fpf-ecosystem-architecture-framework-families-products-and-dpf-suites) and [C.20's construction of a discipline (FPF C.20:4)](FPF-Spec.md#c204---solution---recover-the-whole-from-direct-construction). The requirement for a shared explanation, including alternatives, whole conditions and worked connections, comes from [FPF E.11.PFP:4.7](FPF-Spec.md#e11pfp47---explain-the-methods-at-each-selected-scale).

## Library.Reference:2 - What the names refer to

The same word can name a field, a framework about it or a file. Keep the subject of the claim recoverable before relying on its name.

**FPF Library** names this publication collection; **FPF Core** names its transdisciplinary framework. The Core document retains `FPF` as its DocID, so an address such as `FPF C.39` identifies a Core pattern. Cite **FPF Library** for the collection; name the particular framework and pattern when the claim relies on them.

| Object | What it contributes to this architecture | What a change affects |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Domain | A subject area used to frame a question or organize material. | A revised boundary changes what the designation covers; it does not by itself constitute a discipline. |
| Discipline | A whole of knowledge and reusable practice, with actual constituent relations and a way those contributions constrain and revise one another. | Changes to knowledge, Methods or institutions can preserve the field when its essential connections and continuity conditions remain. |
| Principle framework | An account of recurring situations, problems, forces, Methods, cases, consequences and their relations, expressed as a pattern language. | A revised account can improve the description or change its field promise. |
| Framework edition | An identified body of framework claims about its subject under its reference scheme. In FPF terms, an episteme. | A change in the claims or effective reference scheme identifies another episteme; its continuity and compatibility with earlier editions require their own grounds. |
| DPF Suite | A larger domain framework describing a composite discipline through constituent DPFs and any justified whole-level patterns. | A constituent or connection changes the described whole only under the relevant discipline conditions; editorial inclusion alone supplies no parthood. |
| Product series | A continuing collection of editions under declared admission and reidentification rules. | Admission, retirement and continuity concern the publishing series, separately from the described discipline. |
| Publication carrier and access route | A file, site, rendering or service through which a reader obtains the content. | Availability, layout or retrieval can change while the described Method remains the same. |

These distinctions are developed in [FPF C.20:4.6](FPF-Spec.md#c2046---keep-neighboring-objects-with-their-subject-patterns), [FPF E.4:4.1](FPF-Spec.md#e441---place-support-units-and-adjacent-products-deliberately) and [FPF E.4:4.2](FPF-Spec.md#e442---describe-a-composite-discipline-with-a-dpf-suite). They prevent a practical error: moving a file, giving a publication a name or admitting an edition cannot supply a missing methodological contribution.

A pattern is also distinct from the Method it explains. The text may help a reader perform, criticize or adapt a way of working. The occurrence of that work and its actual result need their own basis. [FPF A.3.1](FPF-Spec.md#a31---umethod-reusable-way-of-doing-with-explicit-applicability) and [FPF A.3.2](FPF-Spec.md#a32---umethoddescription-description-episteme-for-a-way-of-doing) retain that distinction; [FPF A.15.1](FPF-Spec.md#a151---uwork-dated-performed-work-occurrence) supplies the account of performed Work.

## Library.Reference:3 - Why general Methods belong in Core

[FPF Core](FPF-Spec.md) contains both common conceptual distinctions and developed transdisciplinary Methods. Its Kernel is the subset that defines universal meta-concepts and the rules for their meanings and relations. Core also explains how to investigate a question, construct and combine Methods, compare arrangements, qualify claims, make decisions and continue development. The Kernel is not the whole of Core.

The placement question turns on what an operation requires. Constructing a Method from interacting contributions, comparing its performance and provision, or deciding which questions a checklist must answer can apply across fields without importing one field's substantive mechanism. These general constructions belong with their shared conditions in Core. Repeated domain copies add a duty to keep the same general construction consistent.

For example, [FPF C.32.MWA.PP](FPF-Spec.md#c32mwapp---construct-and-compare-method-performance-and-provision-arrangements) constructs and compares complete performance and provision arrangements. [FPF A.15.8.MS](FPF-Spec.md#a158ms---configure-methodological-support-for-work) configures the methodological support that actual work needs. [FPF C.41 and its connected patterns](FPF-Spec.md#c41---select-checklist-questions-for-a-work-result) distinguish selecting checklist questions, making their reusable expression, fitting an occasion, obtaining grounded answers, reconciling shared uses and qualifying the checking means. These remain several Methods with different results, rather than one compulsory checklist process. [FPF E.8.ML](FPF-Spec.md#e8ml---construct-a-pattern-language-for-connected-methods) explains the construction of a pattern language for connected Methods.

Wide applicability alone does not justify Core placement. Mathematical Modeling constructs correspondences, transformations and mathematical consequences under mathematical premises. Research Method Practice reconstructs practice and investigates competing accounts under inquiry-specific evidence conditions. Organization Change Engineering constructs contribution, information, assignment and authority arrangements in an organization whose work continues. The common idea of improving a method does not teach those specialized operations.

The architecture therefore keeps a general construction once and gives its specialized realization an explicit supplier. The test is whether the full operation and its conditions survive a change of subject, and what domain knowledge still has to be supplied. An abstract object, a broad title or use by many professions cannot settle that test. [FPF E.4.PFAD](FPF-Spec.md#e4pfad---principle-framework-architecture-decision) compares the actual contributions and their organization; [FPF E.4.CM](FPF-Spec.md#e4cm---develop-connected-methods-as-framework-contributions) distinguishes an already explained connection from a missing reusable Method.

## Library.Reference:4 - Why these Suites form useful wholes

A Suite describes a field whose knowledge and reusable practices form a larger whole. Its constituent languages remain usable independently, but the Suite also explains the consequential connections: what one contribution constrains, what result another consumes, how failure returns to an affected premise and which substitutions preserve the whole. The four Suites below cover selected portions of their fields, not every practice associated with their broad names. Their subjects and knowledge-practice connections, rather than the current number of files, establish the boundaries.

### Library.Reference:4.1 - Engineering connects knowledge to functioning systems

The [Engineering Suite (Engineering DPF Suite)](DPFs/Engineering%20DPF%20Suite/README.md) is organized around designing, realizing, changing and sustaining functioning systems. This edition directly assembles Systems Engineering, Maintenance Engineering and Management, Knowledge-Corpus Access Engineering and Semantic Integration Engineering. Management describes the organizational specialization, including OCE, and Human Capability Engineering describes the human specialization in §4.4. Their separate Suite editions retain their engineering subjects while making the corresponding specialized knowledge and practices available in full.

Direct constituents and specialized contributions can constrain the same realization. An attainable operator capability can change automation. A maintenance condition can change a design. The meanings carried across an information interface must remain usable in the receiving operation. Organizational authority and protected practice time can determine whether a new way of working becomes possible while existing obligations continue. Qualification and later use can reopen the knowledge or design on which those arrangements depended.

Engineering includes discovering and reformulating the problem, not only executing a settled specification. A particular task can finish with an adequate analysis, design or justified no-change recommendation; a claim that a system actually changed requires that result. Similarly, HCD's engineering contribution concerns constructed and qualified capability development. The fact that all thinking and learning have physical bearers does not make every intellectual or learning activity engineering.

The [Engineering Reference](DPFs/Engineering%20DPF%20Suite/ENGINEERING-DPF-SUITE-REFERENCE.md) explains selected combinations and the external contributions they need. An asset valuation, a research finding or a management commitment can be indispensable without bringing its whole discipline into Engineering.

### Library.Reference:4.2 - Management connects direction to jointly supportable commitments

The [Management Suite (Management DPF Suite)](DPFs/Management%20DPF%20Suite/README.md) concerns directing and sustaining joint activity through worthwhile direction, legitimate and feasible commitments, provision, performance and warranted reconsideration. Its twelve constituent languages are Strategy, Operations Management, Organization Administration, Corporate Governance, Management Accounting, Corporate Finance, Marketing, Customization and Productization Management, Engineering Asset Management, Leadership, Community Management and Organization Change Engineering.

A customer promise constrains operating work. Capacity and existing obligations constrain the promise. Resource and monetary accounts connect that work to funding choices. Authority determines which proposed act can become effective. Participation conditions determine which contributions can actually be relied on. A locally sound answer can therefore fail in the whole: the budget, schedule and promise may depend on the same unavailable resource or on an agreement that has not been made.

[Customization and Productization Management (CUST)](DPFs/Management%20DPF%20Suite/CUSTOMIZATION-AND-PRODUCTIZATION-MANAGEMENT-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) connects decisions about client differences to the provision and continuing obligations they require. Practitioners may use a sufficient existing offering, retain a supported local answer, construct or change a repeatable offering, or decline the request. CUST.1 supplies the complete connected Method; CUST.2–CUST.8 can also be applied directly. A common technical component does not by itself establish a repeatable offer: permitted use, ordinary execution, support and existing client obligations can require a different construction. These management questions receive full engineering, implementation and accounting contributions without duplicating their supplying frameworks.


The composite contribution is a jointly supportable management arrangement, with a return from actual performance to the premise that needs reconsideration. The same construction accommodates a business, public service, temporary collaboration or voluntary community. Corporate Finance and Corporate Governance retain their corporate conditions; membership of the Suite does not impose those conditions on every undertaking.

For an organization as the target system, management specializes the construction and sustained functioning of organized joint work: authority, interests, commitments and resources have their own substantive conditions. A changed allocation or operating commitment can change the organization's state without redesigning its architecture. Management is therefore not separated from engineering by an alleged absence of system change. It also receives independently useful results from other disciplines. A voluntary population or network is not automatically one organization or capability holder; the relevant whole and authority must be established for that use.

Organization Change Engineering belongs directly to Management: organizational constructions constrain feasible commitments, and changed commitments can require another arrangement. Maintenance Engineering and Management belongs directly to Engineering: failure and condition knowledge, maintenance policy, provision and intervention connect to sustained functioning; later functioning can reopen them. Management practitioners can apply the full maintenance Methods themselves or obtain their results. This preserves the technical and management connections inside MNT without making its complete field an additional Management constituent. Each complete language has one home in its respective Suite.

### Library.Reference:4.3 - Foundational Thinking connects formal constructions and their interpretations

The [Foundational Thinking Suite (Foundational Thinking DPF Suite)](DPFs/Foundational%20Thinking%20DPF%20Suite/README.md) connects Mathematical Thinking, Mathematical Modeling, Physical Thinking, Computational Thinking and Notational Engineering. These Methods can produce new objects, explanations, correspondences, algorithms and languages, as well as use existing ones. A subject difficulty can call for a new formal construction; a formal construction can open a new subject question.

A physical account constrains admissible model relations. Mathematical construction derives consequences. An algorithm must obtain the required answer within its resource and interaction conditions. Modelling connects that answer back to the subject question; notation keeps the distinctions operable and their changes recoverable. The whole makes a consequence jointly interpretable and revisable while retaining its separate mathematical, physical, computational and expressive grounds.

An observational mismatch can reopen an idealization; computing the same model more accurately does not repair that premise. A numerical error can require an algorithmic correction without invalidating the physical account. These different returns are part of the field's construction. The [Foundational Thinking Reference](DPFs/Foundational%20Thinking%20DPF%20Suite/FOUNDATIONAL-THINKING-DPF-SUITE-REFERENCE.md) explains such connections.

The name does not designate all thinking or a universal learning sequence. A pure mathematical result can be complete without a physical application. Explanation Design, Research Method Practice and Narrativization have other subjects and remain independent suppliers. Their use of mathematics or notation does not absorb their full fields into this Suite.

### Library.Reference:4.4 - Human Capability Engineering changes the human holder's capabilities

The [Human Capability Engineering Suite (Human Capability Engineering DPF Suite)](DPFs/Human%20Capability%20Engineering%20DPF%20Suite/README.md) concerns forming, changing, restoring and maintaining what a human holder can do. Human designates the target of the change, not necessarily its performer. A human teacher, an organization or suitable AI assistance may contribute; the resulting capability claim still concerns the person. The first edition connects the full Human Capability Development and Somatic Movement Modeling languages.

HCD connects later Work, the person's starting evidence, programme alternatives, practice, provision and qualification. SOM supplies the bodily distinctions, regulation and coordination needed for its movement-learning branch. Their results constrain one another: a programme cannot supply a missing coordination by listing it, and a local movement exercise does not establish performance of the whole task. A dancer may have adequate strength, a stationary axis and a remembered figure while lacking coordination during rotation. The two languages connect the missing bodily contribution to whole-task practice, variation, transfer and retention, rather than treating separate successful exercises as a complete result.

This is a capability-engineering synthesis with limited present coverage. It does not claim all medicine, psychology, personality change or personal management, and it does not imply that these questions are reducible to teaching. When physiological, clinical, motivational or other mechanisms are necessary, their substantive Methods and qualified provision must be obtained. The current two DPFs are the available part of the field, not a reason to close its boundary around the files already written.

The qualification Capability distinguishes this target from the human–system interaction studied in ergonomics. A bounded capability change also differs from open-ended development. The [Human Capability Engineering Reference (HCE)](DPFs/Human%20Capability%20Engineering%20DPF%20Suite/HUMAN-CAPABILITY-ENGINEERING-DPF-SUITE-REFERENCE.md) explains the field, alternatives, available constructions and limits. An assisted answer can satisfy an immediate need without changing the person; acquiring a capability can finish while a wider open-ended development undertaking continues.

## Library.Reference:5 - Why some DPFs stand outside the Suites

A standalone DPF is an independently usable domain language whose own subject and useful results warrant its boundary, without a demonstrated constituent relation to one of the described assemblies in this Library edition. It is not a lesser framework or an item waiting for a folder to complete a classification.

The ten standalone languages have the following distinct contributions:

| DPF | Contribution that retains its own boundary |
| --- | --- |
| [Decision Design (PSDA)](DPFs/DECISION-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) | Constructing a decision situation, ends and possible means, alternatives, consequence and uncertainty accounts and warranted recommendations, together with the engagement, participation and facilitation that make them usable. |
| [Research Method Practice (RMP)](DPFs/RESEARCH-METHOD-PRACTICE-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) | Inquiry and criticized knowledge contributions, including source recovery, observation, research design and evidence limits. |
| [Explanation Design (EXD)](DPFs/EXPLANATION-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) | Making warranted relations recoverable and usable by an intended recipient. |
| [Narrativization and Narrative Studies (NSTD)](DPFs/Narrativization-and-Narrative-Studies-Principles-Framework.md) | Constructing and examining followable narratives with purpose, viewpoint, arrangement and recoverable source relations. |
| [Implementation Facilitation (IS)](DPFs/IMPLEMENTATION-FACILITATION-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) | Agreeing, constructing, adapting and continuing facilitation through which participants make an interpretable practice workable under actual conditions, including brokerage and their further facilitation capability. |
| [Financial Domain Modeling (FDM)](DPFs/FINANCIAL-DOMAIN-MODELING-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) | Financial parties, positions, rights, obligations, events and flows with their domain meanings. |
| [Economic Reasoning and Coordination (ECO)](DPFs/ECONOMIC-REASONING-AND-COORDINATION-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) | Scarcity, incentives, exchange, commitments, institutions and coordination under economic conditions. |
| [Defense and Transmission Modeling (DTM)](DPFs/DEFENSE-AND-TRANSMISSION-MODELING-DPF.md) | Transmission, reconstruction, variants, selection, protection and consequential feedback. |
| [Music and Dance Practice Engineering (MDPE)](DPFs/MUSIC-AND-DANCE-PRACTICE-ENGINEERING-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) | Musical and dance creation, performance, learning, transmission and cultural continuation, including engineered performing configurations and changes to their supporting environment. |
| [Embodied Rhythmics (RHY)](DPFs/EMBODIED-RHYTHMICS-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) | Performed rhythmic relations, their representation, transformation, coordination, practice and observation. |

Within Decision Design, construction of alternatives and professional engagement have different completion conditions. A sound comparison can exist while representation, consent or the conditions for useful advice remain unresolved. Conversely, a well-conducted engagement does not supply a missing mathematical or empirical argument. One language keeps these Methods independently selectable while explaining their necessary connections. Its warranted recommendation is not the authorized choice, implementation of that choice, or engineering of an operational decision service.

Narrativization supplies another case. A narrative can serve inquiry, management, teaching or artistic practice, but its purposes and viewpoint choices are not exhausted by any of those uses. Putting it under every consuming field would confuse use with composition. Leaving it standalone preserves the whole narrative question and its returns to source.

Standalone placement is open to substantive revision. A newly established larger discipline could include a field under [FPF C.20](FPF-Spec.md#c20---composition-of-udiscipline-discipline-cal); a changed problem family could justify repartition.

## Library.Reference:6 - Several relations, not one hierarchy

The Library uses several structures at once. Their relations answer different questions.

| Relation | Architectural consequence | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Discipline parthood | A constituent contributes to the continuing practice-and-knowledge assembly described by a Suite. | Maintenance knowledge and intervention practice participate in Engineering's account of sustained functioning. |
| Method composition | Constituent Methods together obtain the result of a larger Method under their joint conditions. | A way of answering a decision question can combine Methods for obtaining observations, interpreting them and comparing alternatives. |
| Specialization | An inherited construction is developed under additional subject conditions. | Somatic Movement Modeling gives bodily sensing and coordination constructions within human capability development. |
| Supplying use | One Method's result is consumed by another operation under stated conditions. | An engineering choice receives a financial constraint without absorbing Corporate Finance. |
| Framework dependency | A framework relies on claims or Methods in an identified supplying edition. | A domain language uses Core's distinction between capability, assignment and performed Work. |
| Publication assembly | Selected complete descriptions are included with their entries and source returns. | OCE has its full home in the Management Suite and MNT in the Engineering Suite; uses from elsewhere return to those same complete descriptions. |

Discipline parthood is established for the field, Method parthood for the way of working, and Work containment for performed activity. A project's participants and timetable do not establish any of these other relations. [FPF C.32.MWA](FPF-Spec.md#c32mwa---synthesize-an-architecture-account-of-methods-and-their-use) helps recover the Method, Work, capability and provision structures when they do not correspond one-for-one.

The directory tree supplies an unambiguous home for full descriptions. It does not turn all semantic relations into a tree. A claim of multiple disciplinary parthood needs grounds for each assembly; repeated usefulness is insufficient. Nor does a graph with several parents automatically form a mathematical lattice. A formal model requires its selected elements, relation and mathematical properties, as [FPF E.11.PFP:4.7](FPF-Spec.md#e11pfp47---explain-the-methods-at-each-selected-scale) explains.

OCE's organizational construction participates in the Management whole, a specialization of engineering. A management undertaking can also use MNT's full policy or programme Method while maintenance remains a constituent of the broader Engineering edition. In that use the manager can perform the Method: the supplying discipline need not be represented by a different person. Corporate Finance can similarly supply a constraint to an engineering project without that use establishing its whole field as an Engineering constituent. The subject and the relation of the complete field to the whole decide composition; a useful connection alone does not.

The transformed object also differs from the performer and recipient. Replacing a teacher with an AI assistant can leave the human-learning target unchanged. Replacing the learner with a robot changes the target and can require different learning and control Methods. A shared input/output signature does not supply those bodies. Replacing an instrument can change motor demands and attainable musical material; changing listeners or cultural selection can change what is retained for other reasons. The complete MDPE.20 account preserves these distinct mechanisms. The general constructions remain in Core; the bodies that depend on a particular target and mechanism remain with their substantive fields.

## Library.Reference:7 - How the language makes connected work intelligible

The Library's pattern languages are declarative. Their order of publication does not prescribe a project process. A current question selects a relevant contribution; a real dependency requires another result only when the selected operation cannot proceed without it. Existing adequate results can let the reader enter farther along the connection.

The useful connection is more specific than a sequence of titles. A supplying Method returns something of an identified kind, a receiving operation uses it, and the conditions on that result remain available at the join. A model with an error bound may support one decision but not another. A proposed contribution needs agreement and authority before it can be relied on as a commitment. An observed successful run can support a bounded performance claim while leaving transfer or independent capability open.

[FPF C.39](FPF-Spec.md#c39---find-and-develop-a-way-to-obtain-a-result) starts from the result needed by the receiving work and develops a missing way where necessary. [FPF E.4.CM](FPF-Spec.md#e4cm---develop-connected-methods-as-framework-contributions) distinguishes a genuine missing Method or connection from an adequate contribution whose explanation or access needs repair. The larger public accounts make those connections understandable; the bodies supply the developed operations. A link to a related topic cannot fill an unwritten operation.

There is also a connection within ongoing work. While someone checks the units in a calculation, that action can be part of obtaining a model result, comparing a design and supporting a larger engineering decision at the same moment. The encompassing purpose determines which distinctions the check must preserve. [FPF B.1.5.EW](FPF-Spec.md#b15ew---recover-how-constituent-actions-enact-encompassing-work) recovers this constituent-to-whole connection; [FPF B.1.5.RS](FPF-Spec.md#b15rs---evaluate-a-constituent-method-replacement-in-its-encompassing-uses) examines a proposed replacement in its encompassing uses. A missing intermediate capability or unavailable shared resource can defeat the whole even when elementary operations are individually available.

This account applies to human, AI and mixed arrangements. A supplied result and the recipient's own mastery are different goals. [FPF C.32.MWA.PP](FPF-Spec.md#c32mwapp---construct-and-compare-method-performance-and-provision-arrangements) compares complete arrangements, including coordination, checking, waiting and correction; [FPF C.11.DUA](FPF-Spec.md#c11dua---make-advice-and-evidence-demands-worth-their-burden) keeps an additional inquiry or check proportionate to what it could change. Assignment and permission remain separate from capability. The Library supplies ways to reason about the arrangement; the actual situation supplies its facts, powers and available performers.

### Library.Reference:7.1 - When a way works in the small but fails in the large

An analyst's personal tool can work because the analyst interprets its inputs, supplies missing context, checks unusual answers and decides what to do. Asking several units to use the visible calculation autonomously changes that arrangement. More examples of the successful calculation do not establish the meanings, provision, authority or recovery that the new use needs.

“In the small” and “in the large” are useful search expressions for this difficulty, not two sizes to which every Method belongs. One author can create dependencies that require coordinated change; several performers can work independently when the necessary conditions are provided. A larger batch for the same analyst can leave the original way sufficient. Begin with C.39:4.1 to recover what the receiving work needs and what the earlier success depended on. Its remaining Solution constructs the missing contribution and joins it to the useful whole.

The Library keeps the following questions with different fields because their first useful results differ. Use the row that fits the difficulty; the table is not a sequence of prerequisites.

| Difficulty in the receiving work | Read for the needed contribution |
| --- | --- |
| A faster local operation leaves the accepted output unchanged or increases waiting elsewhere. | OPS.9 follows accepted output, waiting and resource occupancy to the current constraint. B.1.5.EW recovers how the constituent action participates in encompassing work; B.1.5.RS examines a proposed replacement in those uses. |
| Independently supplied components or versions do not make one usable configuration. | SYSE.11 develops and qualifies integration for the system's bounded use. For digital executable and documentary components, SYSE.53 selects a compatible configuration. For software and persistent data, SYSE.34 develops coexistence, transition and recovery when versions cannot change together. |
| Contributors need to vary their work without repeatedly involving a central expert. | SYSE.27 derives the extension boundary from the intended independent variation and supplies a reproducible contribution, examples and repair. SIE.12 provides the common semantics actually needed while preserving local models; SIE.7 uses that agreement in implementation. |
| The same identifiers or formats conceal different meanings. | SIE.3 constructs sufficient distinctions, SIE.4 qualifies correspondence and substitution, and SIE.5 distinguishes identity from other relations. A.15.9 obtains a missing result from the appropriate practice and uses it within the supported conditions. |
| Data variants and operations have been extended separately, but their new combination is undefined. | CMP.15 constructs the missing semantic intersection and a composition that reaches it, including nested uses. CMP.12 supplies the interpretation being extended; CMP.14 addresses interaction when state or continuing execution changes the observations. |
| Individual skills are present, but a whole performance or independent capability is missing. | HCD.3 distinguishes capability from conditions and interference; HCD.9, HCD.10 and HCD.12 develop coordinated performance, useful variation and transfer. An external service's successful result does not establish the recipient's own mastery. |
| A workable plan depends on actors who have not agreed, or on a community treated as a permanent project team. | ECO.3 and ECO.4 construct feasible proposals and actual commitments; LDR.2 obtains the responses needed for joint contributions. CB.4 and CB.9 organize participation and maintenance under the community's actual terms. Technical compatibility supplies none of those agreements. |
| Separate accounts of knowledge cannot yet support one warranted conclusion. | F.0.2 compares their claims and meanings; RMP.5 and RMP.6 develop rival explanations and discriminating inquiry. Keep an unresolved difference when the available grounds cannot settle it. |
| Dividing work among people or AI agents loses context, authority or a usable combined result. | SYSE.44 constructs division and recombination against a one-performer alternative. C.32.MWA.PP compares complete performance and provision, including checking and correction. KCAE.SEARCH and KCAE.DELIVER obtain and supply sufficient material; SYSE.52 chooses what the next operation must actually receive. |
| A changed technology may remove an old constraint or open a different contribution. | STR.17 investigates technological change separately from public attention. STR.5 uses a qualified possibility to develop a direction; STR.12 reconsiders an existing commitment when its grounds change. |
| A useful prototype is proposed for a use with different consequences. | C.39 identifies the result needed by the changed use. SYSE.14 develops an engineering release decision with its evidence and authority. For software, SYSE.35 and SYSE.36 qualify bounded exposure and comparison, and SYSE.34 supplies practiced recovery. C.11.DUA helps choose additional inquiry by what it can change, while applicable obligations retain their force. |

Some continuations begin with another representation. To obtain an operational model from documents, use A.3.1.DR for prescribed actions and conditions, SIE.2 and SIE.3 for meanings and the questions the model must answer, NOT.1–NOT.4 for representation and transformation, and CMP.12 for effective interpretation. KCAE.SOURCE preserves the original material for later questions. These results connect through the intended operation; an extracted prescription is not evidence that the described work occurs.

Subject expertise can remain an external contribution. For a production ML change, the general engineering Methods do not teach every test of the relation between an offline score and live effects, differences between training and serving features, or quality loss as a model and its inputs age. Use the external [Google production-ML monitoring guidance](https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/crash-course/production-ml-systems/monitoring) as an entry to that specialist work. Obtain the results needed for the actual system, with their limits, before relying on them; an unresolved result can narrow or stop the affected change. The linked guidance is an instruction source, not a result already supplied by this Reference.

Return each contribution to the original receiving question. If stable inputs, an explicit interpretation and an adequate recovery arrangement restore independent local work, use that arrangement. If only more provision is needed, retain the sufficient Method. If a promised operation is still unwritten, C.39 develops it; a longer list of references does not supply it. The different DPFs keep their own subjects while contributing to this common question, without acquiring additional Suite memberships.

## Library.Reference:8 - A worked connection across the Library

The following constructed case illustrates the architecture. It is not a model of every laboratory or a required sequence of Methods.

Three laboratories want a more dependable diagnostic measurement practice. An existing calculation works for familiar specimens but gives unexplained disagreements for a new class. The groups also want practitioners to handle further unfamiliar cases. They are considering better source access, an external specialist service, a shared support office and local provision coordinated by their leads.

### Library.Reference:8.1 - Different contributions to one useful result

The intended results already reveal several subjects. A functioning measurement arrangement is an engineering result. An explanation of the discrepancy is a knowledge result. A practitioner's ability to recognize and investigate a new case is a capability result. A feasible agreement about contributions is a management result. None can be inferred merely from completion of another.

[Decision Design (PSDA)](DPFs/DECISION-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) helps construct the question and compare alternatives without assuming at the outset that the answer is an office or a course. [Research Method Practice (RMP)](DPFs/RESEARCH-METHOD-PRACTICE-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) supplies inquiry when existing knowledge cannot explain the disagreement. If the issue is a model premise, [Foundational Thinking (Foundational Thinking DPF Suite)](DPFs/Foundational%20Thinking%20DPF%20Suite/README.md) connects physical explanation, model correspondence and calculation. A faster or more accurate computation of the same inadequate model does not resolve that premise.

The resulting explanation changes what must be obtained. If a usable method already exists and the only defect is access, [Implementation Facilitation (IS)](DPFs/IMPLEMENTATION-FACILITATION-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) can supply the missing help. If the desired result is each practitioner's independent judgement, external answers alone are insufficient; [Human Capability Development (HCD)](DPFs/Human%20Capability%20Engineering%20DPF%20Suite/HUMAN-CAPABILITY-DEVELOPMENT-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) supplies the relevant learning and capability qualification. When organizational contributions or authority must change, [Organization Change Engineering (OCE)](DPFs/Management%20DPF%20Suite/ORGANIZATION-CHANGE-ENGINEERING-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) constructs that realization while ongoing obligations remain in view.

The office alternatives concern how these transformations will be performed and supported. [FPF C.32.MWA.PP](FPF-Spec.md#c32mwapp---construct-and-compare-method-performance-and-provision-arrangements) compares their complete performance and provision. A common office for several masteries is a serious alternative when the same contribution can serve them without erasing their different criteria, and the gain from sharing exceeds the extra coordination and interpretation burden. Specialized development support has a case when it supplies methodological inquiry that each workplace lacks while receiving subject expertise from the laboratories. Local leadership, distributed specialists or external provision can be sufficient when those arrangements supply the whole needed contribution under attainable conditions. A label such as common, specialized or AI-assisted establishes none of that sufficiency.

[STR.16](DPFs/Management%20DPF%20Suite/STRATEGY-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#str16---construct-a-feasible-portfolio-with-shared-or-branch-specific-support) compares shared and branch-specific support while preserving each branch's purpose. [LDR.2](DPFs/Management%20DPF%20Suite/LEADERSHIP-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#ldr2---agree-feasible-joint-contributions) obtains responses to a feasible joint proposal. Where independent groups require a common mandate, [CB.13](DPFs/Management%20DPF%20Suite/COMMUNITY-MANAGEMENT-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#cb13---establish-a-workable-mandate-for-shared-decisions) supplies that contribution; the participants retain powers they have not delegated.

Suppose one qualified specialist has eight available hours in the relevant week and each of two distinct activities requires five hours of that specialist's time, including preparation and return. Each activity is individually feasible; the pair needs ten hours. Shared administration does not supply the missing two hours. Different timing, a qualified substitute or a smaller promise can make a different arrangement feasible. The choice depends on which change preserves the required result, not on the number of offices or participants. This is a condition on the whole combination, not a defect in either local Method.

### Library.Reference:8.2 - What a changed condition sends back

If the new specimen class defeats an assumption in the model, the return is to that assumption and its dependent conclusions. If the model remains adequate but the specialist withdraws, the return is to provision and commitments. If the service delivers good answers but practitioners still cannot investigate unfamiliar cases, the missing result is their capability; repeating the service's success does not answer that question. If the scientific result is adequate but its explanation cannot be used at the workplace, [Explanation Design (EXD)](DPFs/EXPLANATION-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) supplies the recipient-relative construction.

These branches show why the Library retains different languages. Research retains its independently useful knowledge result and its own field boundary when this engineering work uses it. Reclassifying every useful supplier as a Management constituent would obscure its own field. Copying their descriptions into a new office framework would add duplication without supplying the missing connection. The existing Methods instead preserve the changed premise, the receiving action and the relevant return.

Once the practice works adequately, one branch can finish. The new understanding may reveal a harder but attainable problem, such as recognizing an unfamiliar failure before it affects a measurement. [FPF C.40.NP](FPF-Spec.md#c40np---continue-from-a-result-to-new-attainable-problems) develops that continuation. If several independent practitioners need to reconstruct and adapt the method, [FPF C.36.RP](FPF-Spec.md#c36rp---sustain-and-renew-shared-ways-of-working) supplies cultural retention and renewal, with [Community Management (CB)](DPFs/Management%20DPF%20Suite/COMMUNITY-MANAGEMENT-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) where participation or common work needs organizing. Neither a permanent office nor an endlessly open project is required by that continuation.

The same architecture can serve a question that has no laboratory or system-realization goal. A mathematical investigation may finish with a warranted construction; a narrative may finish with a source-faithful account suited to its purpose. The example explains relations among contributions, not a boundary around the Library's possible uses.

## Library.Reference:9 - Open-ended development belongs across these fields

Open-ended development expands knowledge, understanding and reproducible ways of obtaining results, then uses that changed starting position to open further worthwhile and attainable problems. The novelty can be new to a person, organization or community without being new to humanity. An adequate knowledge contribution can matter before all prospective applications have been realized.

The general connection is developed in [FPF C.40.OD](FPF-Spec.md#c40od---construct-and-continue-open-ended-development), [FPF C.40.JD](FPF-Spec.md#c40jd---develop-a-way-its-holder-and-its-provision-together) and [FPF C.40.NP](FPF-Spec.md#c40np---continue-from-a-result-to-new-attainable-problems). They connect a consequential difficulty, problematisation, a useful direction, construction of a way, its holder and provision, application and the next possibility. They keep the branch that supplies an immediate result distinct from the branch that develops a performer's capability and the branch that develops the Method itself.

That construction is transdisciplinary. It can concern a person, organization, AI system or distributed cultural carriers while requiring different mechanisms in each case. HCD explains human practice, feedback and transfer. OCE explains organizational realization and authority. RMP explains research. Community Management explains participation where a common undertaking exists. An executable learning system also needs its own challenge representations, learning and transfer mechanisms; the general development account is not their implementation.

The general construction remains incomplete for a concrete use until its needed subject mechanisms are supplied. Keeping those mechanisms in their domain languages preserves their distinct premises, evidence and revision. Putting the general connection inside one domain framework would make a common Method depend on that field. Keeping only scattered citations would leave the reader to invent how a sufficient result opens the next problem. The selected architecture develops the common connection in Core and retains its subject-specific suppliers.

Repeated delivery, a new version or a higher current score alone does not establish this continuation. Nor can a finite observation demonstrate an infinite future. The useful claim concerns the growth actually obtained, the problems it enables and the conditions supporting further development. A bounded service or project can end while its result supports that wider practice.

### Library.Reference:9.1 - Open-ended development through connected contributions

Development can begin with a faint difficulty in ordinary work, a possibility that changes what is worth attempting, or a newly noticed limit after success. The problem, the way forward and the means of development can all need construction. The Methods connected by this account help people conduct that work, join its necessary contributions and continue from the position actually reached. It also retains independently useful opportunity inquiry and advice: a bounded useful result can finish such an undertaking without pretending that development itself is complete.

The developed subject, the provider of help and the chooser of a commitment need not be the same. Self-development is the branch in which the subject itself makes the relevant contribution to conducting its own development. An externally supplied improvement does not establish that contribution. A technical or non-agent subject can develop under another performer's work without being assigned agency by analogy.

#### Library.Reference:9.1.1 - One connected practice and independently useful contributions

The connected question is how a worthwhile change becomes attainable and actual, and how the changed position becomes a basis for further development. C.40.OD supplies the construction linking current work, problematisation, direction and Method construction, performer preparation, provision, consequential work and further inquiry. STR.16 handles a different recurring difficulty: independently worthwhile undertakings whose shared means and support must fit together. The opportunity and advice branches below supply useful results within that practice and remain usable independently.

**Connected formulation.** Notice what matters in the current situation; make the unresolved question worth answering; construct a reachable change with its means; qualify the contributions together; obtain the real commitment and provision; perform the work and distinguish the result from what was learned; use the changed position to find the next worthwhile attainable problem; improve the way development is done when that change is worth its cost. Enter at an adequate existing result, preserve independent work, and return to the particular missing contribution when a connection fails.

This formulation helps retain the joins explained by the patterns. It is not a compulsory lifecycle or an assertion that every described relation already obtains. A local performance can skip unnecessary learning because a qualified performer exists. A known adequate Method can avoid fresh research. A genuine inquiry can continue for its own scientific result without waiting for a sale. A branch can end, rest or consolidate while the subject retains a way to notice and pursue its next development. Endless activity and ever-larger obligations are not the meaning of open continuation.

The practical result of one complete use is a meaningful bounded start, actual work through qualified Methods, an intelligible account of the changed contribution and a reasoned next development question. It need not be a document package. Where a company or provider needs strategic descriptions, programmes, work arrangements and learning material, those are expressions of the relevant construction and separate instructional work; their existence is not evidence of the capability they describe.

#### Library.Reference:9.1.2 - What result are we trying to obtain?

A request for a development office can name a proposed arrangement before anyone has established its useful result. Recover that result first. Does a person need to perform some current work, become able to perform it, organize their own further development, or help others become able to continue? Does a provider need a viable offer, a company need a different capability, or a community need useful participation? These results can depend on each other without being the same.

[FPF C.40.OI and C.40.OC](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#c40oi---bound-an-opportunity-inquiry) help bound the inquiry and characterize the subject and intended change. [PSDA.19](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/DPFs/DECISION-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#psda19---bound-the-development-direction-advising-engagement) bounds help when the adviser, recipient, sponsor and choice owner differ. Their result can be a better bounded inquiry or a qualified stop, not a compulsory programme.

Use [Human Capability Development (HCD)](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/DPFs/Human%20Capability%20Engineering%20DPF%20Suite/HUMAN-CAPABILITY-DEVELOPMENT-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) when a person must acquire the ability; use an adequate available service when supplied performance is sufficient. Neither route alone establishes self-development. Continue to the connected undertaking only when the receiving work needs that larger result.

#### Library.Reference:9.1.3 - Where does development begin, and what happens after success?

Development need not start with a chosen practice or an explicit problem. Recurrent workarounds, a surprising success, an avoided task or a narrowing of attainable possibilities can justify inquiry. The Core opportunity Methods [FPF C.40.OI, C.40.OC, C.40.NU, C.40.PC and C.40.DC](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#c40oi---bound-an-opportunity-inquiry) connect such inquiry to a worthwhile problem, possible directions and the support they need. An adequate established answer can end that inquiry; creating novelty is not a condition of useful work.

[FPF C.40.OD](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#c40od---construct-and-continue-open-ended-development) connects the proposed transition, its realization and continuation from the changed position. Its worked case shows why successful delivery of the current result is different from the subject becoming able to organize a further development problem. The next problem may be harder because earlier limitations have been removed, but escalation without a worthwhile attainable gain is not development discipline.

For an unknown way to obtain the result, follow [FPF C.39](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#c39---find-and-develop-a-way-to-obtain-a-result) and the C.40 opportunity and development Methods. For improvement of the means of development, distinguish changing a Method or its provision from changing a holder's capability. Use E.23.CDI when a named holder must become more capable of conducting the development Work: identify its current limitation, choose an intervention and qualify the resulting capability in representative Work. A Method edit alone does not establish that change. A sufficient contribution ends the local inquiry; continuing development opens the next substantive question.

#### Library.Reference:9.1.4 - How do the different transformations form one undertaking?

Ordinary work, inquiry, changed subject capability, construction of products and Methods, support provision and cultural continuation must supply one another where the intended result depends on them.

Use [FPF C.40.OD:4](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#c40od4---solution). It develops the typical connections and their conditional returns, including an adequate external contribution that changes which work the undertaking must perform itself. The result is a proposed connected undertaking with identifiable receiving contributions and conditions, not an already operating organization. Its worked case provides the construction at a size that can be inspected and adapted.

An actual transformation-flow network claim uses the distinct flow and network rules in [FPF E.18](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#e18---transformation-flow-structure) and [FPF E.18.NET](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#e18net---network-of-transformation-flow-structures). Methods, performed work, receiving dependencies and shared resources remain different relations. If only one adequate contribution is needed, there is no obligation to model a whole network. If a connection cannot be constructed from the supplied Methods, return that missing contribution to its actual practice.

#### Library.Reference:9.1.5 - Who should perform and support the Methods?

Compare complete arrangements, not office names. The same development work might be performed through ordinary managers and workplaces, a specialist development office, a common service for several masteries, a federation, an external provider or an extensive AI arrangement. Methods, capability, resources and powers must be connected without assuming that their structures coincide.

[FPF C.32.MWA.PP](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#c32mwapp---construct-and-compare-method-performance-and-provision-arrangements) constructs these alternatives from the supplied practice and receiving result. It distinguishes the subject's necessary own contribution from substitutable provision, exposes joint demand and authority, and compares shared and specialized support. Its examples include a company without a new office, voluntary external participants and qualified AI. Current [Organization Change Engineering (OCE)](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/DPFs/Management%20DPF%20Suite/ORGANIZATION-CHANGE-ENGINEERING-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md) supplies the actual organizational design and realization where an organization is the governed subject.

A tunnel-building company may need technical performance, learning and continued development. That does not decide that one office should own all three. A specialist development provider can obtain technical expertise from elsewhere while preserving its own strategic remit. Conversely, a common service can share genuinely common provision without treating every mastery as interchangeable. The Method compares these conditions and their whole costs.

Stop when the current or selected arrangement is sufficient for the next use. Return to C.32.MWA.PP when the work, capacity, provider, mandate or means change enough to alter that answer. A Method architecture does not itself appoint staff or grant powers.

#### Library.Reference:9.1.6 - What help, learning and cultural continuation are needed?

These are different questions with different sufficient answers.

| Missing contribution | Useful entry and result | Ordinary boundary or return |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Help through which an interpretable practice becomes workable | [Implementation Facilitation (IS)](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/DPFs/IMPLEMENTATION-FACILITATION-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md), IS.1–3 and IS.5–8: a bounded help relationship, diagnosis, support strategy and continuation or end; [FPF A.3.1.MI](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#a31mi---introduce-a-method-into-practice-and-decide-what-to-keep-or-change) supplies introduction, examination of later use and the keep/change decision | An unknown development direction returns to C.40.OI and the opportunity Methods; an unknown subject Method returns to its field or the general methodological constructions in Core. |
| A person must become capable, rather than receive a service | [Human Capability Development (HCD)](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/DPFs/Human%20Capability%20Engineering%20DPF%20Suite/HUMAN-CAPABILITY-DEVELOPMENT-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md): learning purpose, prepared practice, feedback and transfer | Competent provider performance is not evidence of the recipient's learning; adequate existing competence may need only access or support. |
| Useful participation, relationships or joint contributions | [Community Management (CB)](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/DPFs/Management%20DPF%20Suite/COMMUNITY-MANAGEMENT-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md), starting at CB.1 or the known missing Method | Do not create a community when independent use of an available resource is enough. Employment does not by itself establish community participation or voluntary mandate. |
| A practice must continue among further carriers, including independent people, collectives or AI | [FPF C.36](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#c36---cultural-evolution-and-cultural-evolution-engineering) and [FPF C.36.RP](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#c36rp---sustain-and-renew-shared-ways-of-working), with the subject practice's actual sources | Transmission or participation counts do not establish reconstruction, use or capacity to continue. Follow the direct cultural Method even when there is no community organizer. |

For a culture of development, combine the actual cultural continuation contribution with C.40.OD's development result. Reproducing a training activity or one mastered Method does not show that further carriers can notice a consequential difficulty or possibility, construct a worthwhile development problem, and organize the next attainable transition. A local helping undertaking can nevertheless finish legitimately before that larger culture claim is established.

#### Library.Reference:9.1.7 - How does a useful episode become a renewable cultural contribution?

Make the reason for the way recoverable, not just the appearance of the successful example. [FPF C.36.MC:4.5](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#c36mc45---make-a-practice-recoverable-and-changeable-by-its-recipients) connects receiving work, the explanation of consequential choices, bounded adaptation, recipient use and the return of a useful difference. [FPF C.36.RP](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#c36rp---sustain-and-renew-shared-ways-of-working) obtains and renews the means of using a shared way, whether through material, capable help, tools, learning or another arrangement.

Within a community, [CB.14](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/DPFs/Management%20DPF%20Suite/COMMUNITY-MANAGEMENT-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#cb14---develop-and-maintain-a-shared-repertoire-of-practice) turns contrasting cases into a qualified repertoire contribution and makes it available beyond the people who developed it. Determine whether an observed difference calls for changing the Method, its explanation, a tool, access or the participant's capability; involve the contributor able to make that change. A successful local variant can be worth retaining even when the earlier way remains sound elsewhere.

Keep reconstruction, useful performance, adaptation and later retention as separate claims. A public resource may reach independent carriers who never join a meeting. Conversely, repeated participation may leave a necessary operation unavailable. Keep only the observations needed for the intended claim and obtain further evidence when its possible contribution warrants the burden.

For a culture of continuing development, what another carrier must reconstruct includes recognising a consequential difficulty, framing a worthwhile problem and organising an attainable next transition. [FPF C.40.NP](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#c40np---continue-from-a-result-to-new-attainable-problems) develops that continuation after success. If the next carrier can only repeat the founder's prepared exercise, their ability to choose and address a new problem remains unestablished.

#### Library.Reference:9.1.8 - What should be kept, revised or stopped?

Compare the result with the intended benefit and conditions of use. Delivered assistance, acquired mastery, changed organisational capability, useful participation and cultural continuation need their own grounds. [CB.10](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/DPFs/Management%20DPF%20Suite/COMMUNITY-MANAGEMENT-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#cb10---understand-the-value-of-participation-and-cultural-work) examines the value of participation and cultural work; [FPF C.32.MWA.PP:4.10](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#c32mwapp410---change-the-arrangement-while-preserving-its-valid-uses) follows a changed condition through the affected provision arrangement. Course attendance or a lower complaint count cannot alone settle these different claims.

Retain supported uses when another use fails. A lost permission may block one shared case without invalidating the Method. A provider's departure may defeat timely help while the material remains adequate. Repair the affected contribution, change the promise or obtain another provider. [IS.5](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/DPFs/IMPLEMENTATION-FACILITATION-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#is5---sustain-transfer-extend-or-end-implementation-support) handles continuation or withdrawal of implementation support; [CB.11](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/DPFs/Management%20DPF%20Suite/COMMUNITY-MANAGEMENT-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#cb11---continue-change-transfer-or-end-a-community-arrangement) handles the community arrangement's continuation, transfer or end.

After a sufficient result, use the changed starting point to choose a further worthwhile, more demanding but still attainable problem through C.40.NP. Consolidation, rest or ending an exhausted branch can protect that possibility. A support engagement may end before the recipient's development does.

#### Library.Reference:9.1.9 - What changes when capable AI becomes inexpensive?

Recompare the whole arrangement. A qualified agent may supply inquiry, source recovery, construction, explanation, practice feedback or an authorized decision. The changed viable division of work can remove a specialist bottleneck or an unnecessary office.

Use [C.32.MWA.PP's AI case (FPF C.32.MWA.PP:5.6)](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#c32mwapp56---capable-ai-changes-the-whole-arrangement-not-just-the-coachs-speed) to compare complete performance and support arrangements under the changed AI capability. Use [FPF C.11.DUA](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#c11dua---make-advice-and-evidence-demands-worth-their-burden) to judge what the advice to change that arrangement, or its demands for further inquiry and checking, can obtain relative to their full burden. Include the actual capability, access, context, powers, qualification, shared capacity and consequences of error. Remove human duplication only when the replacement supplies the contribution on which the receiving result depends. Do not retain people merely because an earlier arrangement had them; do not assume a general capability claim supplies the required local judgement or authorization.

If the intended gain is a human's mastery or self-development, AI performing all of the work can defeat that gain even when the immediate output improves. If the gain is an externally supplied result, requiring the human to learn the provider's Method may add waste. Return to the intended result, then change the performance and support arrangement. The worked costs in these Methods are prospective models, not measured universal savings.

#### Library.Reference:9.1.10 - How does the selected practice become usable locally?

To realize a selected proposal, the responsible performers need usable Methods, actual means and powers, sufficient preparation, commitments and an entry into real work.

Follow [FPF C.32.MWA.PP:4.9](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#c32mwapp49---give-the-selected-realization-its-exact-contribution-and-conditions) to the actual missing contribution. [FPF A.15.8.MS](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#a158ms---configure-methodological-support-for-work) makes Method material usable; [FPF A.3.1.MI](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#a31mi---introduce-a-method-into-practice-and-decide-what-to-keep-or-change) introduces the Method and examines later use; OCE.9 realizes an organizational change; Implementation Facilitation provides and adapts the helping undertaking; HCD develops a person's needed capability. An adequate already available contribution ends its branch. A changed result or dependency returns to the supplying Method and the affected whole.

Use [FPF E.4.DPF](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#e4dpf---domain-and-local-principle-frameworks-whether-and-how-to-author-and-publish) when a bounded local practice needs an LPF language. Keep local decisions and examples distinct from the general Method, retain its supplier and conditions, and revise local guidance when those conditions change. A hierarchy of projects does not imply a hierarchy of copied frameworks. A service description, programme, assignment or architecture decision remains its own kind of document.

#### Library.Reference:9.1.11 - From an available result to a useful return

C.40.OI bounds the inquiry; C.40.OC makes the subject's relevant characteristics, current readings, intended changes and unknowns explicit. C.40.NU varies uses, technologies, characteristics and supports. C.40.PC asks what worthwhile receiving problem the proposed contribution would answer. C.40.DC keeps that contribution with the configuration needed to obtain it.

Enter at the first missing result. A team with a sound inquiry can search without repeating intake. A practitioner with a qualified direction can examine its joint conditions through [FPF C.40.JF](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#c40jf---qualify-dependencies-and-joint-reachability). [FPF C.40.OP](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#c40op---maintain-opportunities-and-stepping-stones) can retain useful possibilities and conditional enabling relations without selecting a programme or committing resources. If responsible advice is wanted, use the actual missing service or Decision Design contribution. A request for a specialist result is fulfilled by an adequate return, not by sending the request.

This division preserves useful work at several stopping points. An inquiry can end with a better question. A direction can remain useful while one permission or support result is missing. A retained path can name a later possibility without asserting that its first step happened. The person or arrangement with the relevant authority retains each choice and intervention.

When the needed result is a continuing development undertaking, carry these returns into C.40.OD. It connects them with the professional work that can realize and qualify the change. When independently worthwhile undertakings draw on common means, STR.16 constructs the joint portfolio and compares support arrangements; Strategy still supplies strategic commitment and the actual holders make the decisions. Neither addition changes the finite result or non-use boundary of the opportunity and advising Methods.

#### Library.Reference:9.1.12 - Qualify the combination as well as its ingredients

Joining results requires three judgements: each result is adequately qualified; it fits the receiving subject, configuration, use and horizon; and the proposed combination meets its shared conditions. A sound result for another data class or support arrangement may fail the second judgement. Individually feasible directions can fail the third.

For the combined use, establish the receiving contribution, compatible premises, jointly available resources and permissions, protected conditions and the remaining uncertainty. Identify the next responsible receiver for a missing result. Reuse the detailed qualifications already supplied by the patterns and direct practices; a new combined demand, audience, configuration or horizon needs its own answer. Recognition means that a reader can recover this account. Assurance requires the actual measurements, domain evidence, competence, permissions and other qualified results on which it relies.

In C.40.JF's constructed eight-week case, directions A and B each require the same specialist for two hours every week; only two hours are available after existing obligations. Each direction fits alone. Together they need four hours and fail the joint condition under the no-overtime and urgent-cover protections. Doing A and then B takes sixteen weeks, outside the eight-week horizon. Shared support would be another configuration whose combined demand needs qualification. Preserve the individual directions and the exact joint limit. A combined-work estimate, alternative-support result, or revised-horizon result becomes a request only when its obtainable contribution warrants acquisition.

[FPF C.40.JF:5.4](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#c40jf54---all-pairs-fit-but-the-whole-combination-does-not) distinguishes pairwise from whole feasibility; ruling out the full combination leaves the choice of a subset open.

**Constituent actions in ongoing work.** During programme advising, estimating a participant's available practice time can be part of comparing the feasibility of directions, which is itself part of constructing advice for that participant. If the intended programme requires coordinated practice with a partner, solitary free time is no longer the same usable resource. Arithmetic skill and knowledge of the desired profession can coexist with a missing ability to construct a feasible practice arrangement. Recover that intermediate contribution and its support before recommending the programme. B.1.5.EW supplies the general vertical question; the domain and HCD supply the requisite Methods and capability account. A feasible single step does not establish the feasibility of the advised combination.

#### Library.Reference:9.1.13 - Architectural rationale

The connected repertoire supplies three scales of result without treating them as interchangeable. A worthwhile opportunity or responsible advice can be enough for a bounded inquiry. A development undertaking needs the further joins by which necessary contributions become usable together, work occurs and a new position is obtained. A provider or organization with several independent ends needs a portfolio whose common demand and support can be chosen coherently. The shorter result remains useful without claiming the larger one.

The opportunity and advising Methods retain opportunity construction and advice because their results are reused in the larger practice and can be sought independently. C.40.OD supplies the missing connected construction; its subject-specific learning, engineering, inquiry, cultural and organization work use their actual professional suppliers. STR.16 supplies the joining construction for independent purposes, shared support, resource competition and real commitments. Retaining a possibility in C.40.OP does not allocate it, and comparing a human programme in HCD.2 does not construct an organization's research/product/development portfolio.

Using Decision Design alone remains a serious simpler alternative for a recommendation question with adequate inputs. HCD, OCE, Strategy or another professional Method can likewise finish their own question directly. A list of those suppliers is insufficient when the reader still has to invent how their outputs become one feasible development undertaking or how the first success opens a different worthwhile question. The connected Methods make that joining work explicit without absorbing the supplying disciplines.

The connected repertoire is broader than one composite Method. A framework may offer several independently reusable ways whose results constrain one another; its publication Parts are not Method constituents or a mandatory action order. C.40.OC's suffix remains an address, not proof of specialization or parthood. A supplied domain result is a premise under qualified conditions, not the domain's entire Method.

The opportunity, advice and continuing-practice contributions are independently useful. This architectural reference connects the complete Core patterns and domain-framework publications so that a practitioner can discover and use their joins while retaining precise PatternIDs. A separate publication becomes preferable when a branch has an independently useful whole and the revised distribution serves its use, learning and change better. Reconsider the organization when changed uses or contributions make another arrangement more useful.

A useful narrower profile can inherit applicable guidance and explain its changed situation, contribution, conditions and evidence needs. More than one level of narrowing is possible, and a contribution can serve several profiles. State whether the actual relation is bounded-use projection, specialization, composition, reuse or result dependence.

#### Library.Reference:9.1.14 - Covered work and independent entry

The covered work is conducting and improving a named subject's development, including self-development when that subject contributes to conducting its own development. Recurring questions include unnoticed difficulty, an unformed aspiration, construction of a worthwhile problem, reachable directions and means, joint provision, enactment, actual changed possibilities and continuation after success. Ordinary work, implementation, advice, learning and Method creation can each contribute; none alone defines the whole.

C.40.OD constructs the connected undertaking using the qualified subject and professional results it needs. STR.16 constructs a feasible portfolio for an organization or provider with independently worthwhile undertakings and shared means. Opportunity construction uses C.40.OI, C.40.OC and C.40.NU, C.40.PC, C.40.DC, C.40.JF and C.40.OP without requiring an adviser. Advising can start with a formed question, qualified opportunity or existing HCD.2 programme comparison. Shared inquiry, characterization, joint conditions and changed-premise qualification remain results to obtain when missing, not mandatory checkpoints.

The supplying Core and domain-framework publications contain the complete pattern bodies, their material connections and heterogeneous worked uses. This architectural reference connects those contributions; it does not reproduce every engineering, learning, cultural, research, financial or legal mechanism needed by every development subject. The direct supplier result and conditions remain part of the receiving construction. If that result is unavailable, keep the particular gap; a coherent network drawing does not close it.

[PSDA.Application:4](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/DPFs/DECISION-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#psdaapplication4---app-psd-04--miras-development-direction-programme-comparison-and-guide) follows a person-to-Guide use, [PSDA.Application:5](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/DPFs/DECISION-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#psdaapplication5---app-psd-05--an-engineering-companys-next-development-opportunities) an organization inquiry, and [PSDA.Application:6](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/DPFs/DECISION-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-FRAMEWORK.md#psdaapplication6---app-psd-06--unlike-subjects-exact-recipients-and-an-anti-case) unlike subjects. C.40.OD adds a connected undertaking with two substantive development transitions and changed performing arrangements. STR.16 adds a provider portfolio, a decision-reversing resource change and an external research partner. These are teaching cases, not an empirical coverage claim or the Method's scope boundary.

[FPF C.40.CD](https://github.com/ailev/FPF/blob/main/FPF-Spec.md#c40cd---develop-problems-and-ways-of-solving-them-together) when problems and ways of answering them develop together. | A suggested application enters C.40.NU or C.40.PC as a lead or hypothesis. A local result can be useful without establishing demand, a development opportunity or a qualified future path. |
